labels.assemble_turn_context: 装配固定规则、checkpoint 语义历史与当前 turn 内容
labels.execute_one_child_turn: 执行已准入的单个 native child turn
labels.collect_turn_facts: 收集当前 turn 的原始工具结果、子任务决定、证据引用与失败状态
labels.derive_semantic_candidate: 由模型在 humanagent_turn_end 生成四段语义收拢，并在 humanagent_child_deliver 独立提炼 child 结果；Runtime 校验 scope、证据引用与 child 采纳关系
labels.save_checkpoint_boundary: 通过唯一 checkpoint 保存边界提交四段语义、已验证引用与已采纳 child 结果
labels.project_success_disposition: 仅当完整 durable receipt 且无未决责任时投影成功候选
labels.recovery_hold: 汇总首错、后续错误、raw、未决操作、阶段与恢复责任
labels.assess_turn_disposition: 汇合成功候选与恢复保持并返回唯一处置

design.failurePropagation: Expected failures are typed envelope values, not Operator transport failures. A failed or ineligible prerequisite gates every later side-effect stage; it returns not-executed carrying original cause and recovery responsibility. The pure success projection and pure recovery_hold projection both run and join at the unique Z node; exactly one is active by envelope state. No conditional edge is claimed.
design.routingEvidence: DAGpipe 0.1.1 installed SDK edge schema contains only from/to/arc_id and scheduler schedules every node in each topological wave. This graph is a target topology and contract, not runtime conditional-routing evidence.
design.semanticCheckpointBoundary: The model authors the four-part humanagent_turn_end summary (goal, actions, result, expectedNextStep). Each part carries text and evidenceRefs. Runtime accepts only evidence bound to the current admitted turn or its admitted base refs. Adopted child deliveries enter only through child.adopt. A deterministic per-tool SemanticClaim extractor and forced claims/constraints arrays are not required.
design.enabledToolSurface: The review union is 17 tools: 12 base Responses tools, humanagent_turn_end, child.call, child.adopt, child.not_select and humanagent_child_deliver. This is not a per-request enablement claim. Base tools depend on the bound route and request surface; the three parent child controls require a child roster; child delivery belongs to a child run; turn end is the standard closure action where that closure path is admitted.
design.toolSemanticRules: Semantic extraction is authored at humanagent_child_deliver and humanagent_turn_end, not by a new runtime parser for every tool. Each conclusion keeps tool identity, exact scope, completeness or truncation, failure or unresolved state, whether the executor only performed an action or evidence verified the result, and exact [HumanAgent evidence refs]. No new tool or feature is introduced.
design.rawCurrentAndSemanticPriorBoundary: Current-turn raw tool calls and results remain available in the active turn for model compression. A completed prior turn contributes only the committed four-part semantic checkpoint, verified evidenceRefs and adopted child refined deliveries. Prior raw calls, raw tool bodies, call IDs and child transcripts do not enter prior semantic history.
design.wireProjectionStatus: PARTIAL-WIRE-VERIFIED. Three App semantic-checkpoint encoders project existing checkpointId, committedAt, description and top-level evidenceRefs. Actual captured two-turn/three-turn POST cases changed from RED 2/2 for missing checkpointId to GREEN 2/2 and exercise v1. The v2 and child-run encoder branches are source-fixed but runtime UNVERIFIED. AdoptedChildSemanticContext/AdoptedChildSemanticDelivery have no evidenceRefs field; RefinedChildSemanticDelivery is a different existing type. No child evidenceRefs field was added, and the historical type gap remains. Overall goal is not complete.
design.rawRetention: Keep current-turn raw evidence until a complete durable turn receipt exists. Keep immutable Journal facts, artifact references and semantic evidence references after raw leaves active context.
design.publicationBoundary: Publishing semantic history alone does not close the turn or grant next-turn eligibility.
design.f1HTypedFactBoundary: ProviderToolResult.executionFact attachment is the intended validated fact boundary. This is a target contract; no runtime behavior is established by this graph update.

factCollectionEdge.note: The edge remains unchanged in topology. The intended input includes the validated ProviderToolResult.executionFact attachment; its producer and Runtime consumer still require separate contract and implementation gates.

qualifiedFactBoundary.trustedIdentity: The fact identity must be derived from trusted outer execution context, not from the fact body, report prose, Provider session identity, or a bare call reference.
qualifiedFactBoundary.requiredRelationValidation: Public relation validation must bind the replay event, request, call, tool, operation, status, state, result ref and result digest to the trusted expected ToolIdentity and request before a ToolExecutionFact is admitted.
qualifiedFactBoundary.pendingFinding: H-A2 P1 remains unimplemented and has not passed independent review; this graph records the required boundary only.

design.rawToolResultBoundary: Every current tool result remains raw evidence with its original status, failure, scope, completeness, truncation and result fields. Historical file.search report validation and the test-only deriveFileSearchObservation evidence remain historical source evidence. They are not a general qualification gate for the native 17-tool surface.
design.projectionAuthority: UI projection journal replay can demonstrate observation readback only; it is not Organ Journal authority and does not prove authoritative recovery state.
design.checkpointAndRawReleaseEligibility: Current-turn raw bytes, semantic text, UI projection replay and model-authored summaries are evidence or semantic material only. None is checkpoint, recovery, closure, next-turn, reentry or raw-release authority. The checkpoint/control owner and five-phase coordinator retain those decisions. Raw remains retained until the complete durable turn receipt boundary is proven.
